import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendSoulPathComparison } from '@src/api/bot/battle-attributes';
import { getBackendRealmAccess } from '@src/api/bot/realm-access-queries';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addSoulEffectChanges, addSoulQuote, sendSoulGui } from '@src/response/soulPath/shared';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  try {
    if (!e?.UserId || !e.uid || !(await getBackendRealmAccess(e.UserId)).canUseSoulPath) {
      md.addText('元婴及以上方可进行道途印证。');
      await message.send(sendSoulGui(e, '道途印证', md));

      return;
    }
    const { changes, emptyMessage, quote } = await getBackendSoulPathComparison(e?.UserId, e.uid as number);

    md.addBold('道途加成');
    md.addNewline();
    addSoulEffectChanges(md, changes, emptyMessage);
    addSoulQuote(md, quote);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('[道途印证] 属性计算失败', error);
    md.addText('属性暂时无法计算，请稍后重试。');
  }
  await message.send(
    sendSoulGui(e, '道途印证', md, [
      { label: '返回道途', command: '/元婴道途' },
      { label: '本命物', command: '/我的本命物' }
    ])
  );
});
